summary: Compass Digital Acquisition Corp. (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting termination of its merger agreement with Key Mining Corp. on July 14, 2026, as closing conditions were not met by the June 30, 2026 outside date. Shareholders approved adjournment of an extraordinary general meeting indefinitely, but an extension proposal was not presented, leaving the July 20, 2026 deadline intact. The board decided to cease operations, wind up, and redeem Class A ordinary shares from the trust account at a per-share price equal to the aggregate amount then on deposit, plus interest not previously released. The filing indicates a mandatory liquidation following failed business combination. No deal terms apply as the merger was terminated.
